title: Polarized Negative Power Coupling
caption: Polarized Negative Power Coupling (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Whenever a player plays a Used Interrupt, their opponent may stack it here. Either player may use 2 Force to place a card here in owner’s Used Pile or may lose 2 Force to place a card here in owner’s Lost Pile.
lore: Imbalance in a converter’s inverse energy field can improperly polarize the negative axis, causing hyperdrive failure. Replacement often requires an inverted engineer.
